ValidationRule.description:
Field: Use Case, Challenges, Goals/Benefit - required at Stage of Propose or later
11/12/25 - 00016877 - removed Pains & Goals from Or section that has Description still. 1/26/25 - Updated message to only says Use Case is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Propose"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contract"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Approve"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), OR ( ISBLANK( Description ) ) , ISBLANK( Project__c ) , NOT(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'True_Up') ) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6') && NOT(ISCHANGED(Project__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use Case cannot be blank after Stage of Propose or later.
